michael_dialogue.name: Scenario background
michael_dialogue.text:
Michael is a senior software engineer who is working in a game company. He always try to avoid the CCTV camera.
Now he is talking his awful experience when he is walking on the street.

michael_dialogue.name: Michael
michael_dialogue.title: Senior Software Engineer
michael_dialogue.text: I feel so frustrated due to the CCTV camera!

michael_dialogue.name: Michael
michael_dialogue.title: Senior Software Engineer
michael_dialogue.text:
If I crossover at the front of the CCTV camera, 
it is <yellow>high possibility</yellow> that the police will come out and ask me some questions.

michael_dialogue.name: Michael
michael_dialogue.title: Senior Software Engineer
michael_dialogue.text: It is so annoying that I can't even walk on the street normally, even I don't do any illegal action!!!
